Outside of work, I am a hobbyist photographer, virtual pilot and an S1-rated air traffic controller with VATUSA - [VATSIM](https://www.vatsim.net){target="_blank"}'s United States division.

/* hide the native TOC "On this page" label */
#toc-title { display: none; }

/* ── Unified Gallery Styles ── */
.fj-gallery { margin: 18px 0 32px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.6s ease; max-width: 100%; }
.fj-gallery.is-ready { opacity: 1; }

.fj-gallery .gallery-item {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 8px; /* Smooth rounded corners */
  display: block;
  transform: translateZ(0); /* Prevents zoom from breaking the border-radius mask in WebKit */
  cursor: zoom-in;
}

.fj-gallery .gallery-item img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.6s ease, filter 0.6s ease;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* Hover Zoom & Darken */
.fj-gallery .gallery-item:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  filter: brightness(0.7);
}

/* Magnifying Glass Icon Overlay */
.fj-gallery .lg-hover {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  font-size: 1.5rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; pointer-events: none;
}
.fj-gallery .gallery-item:hover .lg-hover { opacity: 1; }

/* Lightbox caption uses the page font */
.lg-sub-html, .lg-sub-html * { font-family: var(--main-font, inherit) !important; }

## Flight Simulation

I am a virtual Seattle ARTCC controller on VATSIM, and I enjoy being a part of such a wonderful community! Controlling virtual air traffic is a fun and challenging hobby which keeps me on my toes. I also fly (virtually).

<div id="av-gallery" class="fj-gallery" style="max-width: 1200px;"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  var shots = [
    { file: "assets/flight-sim/Screenshot 2026-07-13 043136.png", caption: "From the scope: ASDE-X, an advanced airport surface surveillance system." },
    { file: "assets/flight-sim/kpdx-tower-cab.png",               caption: "Tower Control Cabin" },
    { file: "assets/flight-sim/Screenshot 2026-01-17 161641.png", caption: "Mt. Rainier seen during a flight from Seattle to Los Angeles" },
    { file: "assets/flight-sim/737max8.png",                      caption: "United Airlines Boeing 737 Max 8 from Seattle (KSEA) to San Francisco (KSFO)" },
    { file: "assets/flight-sim/a350-night.png",                   caption: "Delta Airlines Airbus A350-900 - Late evening flight from Detroit (KDTW) to Atlanta (KATL)" },
    { file: "assets/flight-sim/swa-737max.png",                   caption: "Southwest Airlines Boeing 737 Max 8 - Dallas Love Field (KDAL) to Washington National Airport (KDCA)" }
  ];

  var gallery = document.getElementById("av-gallery");
  if (!gallery) return;

  gallery.innerHTML = shots.map(function (s) {
    var cap = s.caption ? s.caption.replace(/"/g, "&quot;") : "";
    var capAttr = cap ? ' data-sub-html="' + cap + '"' : '';
    return '<a class="fj-gallery-item gallery-item" href="' + s.file + '"' + capAttr + '>'
         +   '<img src="' + s.file + '" alt="' + cap + '">'
         +   '<span class="lg-hover"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass-plus"></i></span>'
         + '</a>';
  }).join("");

  function rowH() {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    return w < 600 ? 120 : (w < 1000 ? 150 : 170);
  }

  var tries = 0;
  function init() {
    if (typeof fjGallery === "undefined" || typeof lightGallery === "undefined") {
      if (++tries > 60) { gallery.classList.add("is-ready"); return; }
      setTimeout(init, 50);
      return;
    }

    fjGallery(gallery, {
      itemSelector: ".fj-gallery-item",
      rowHeight: rowH(),
      gutter: 10,
      lastRow: "left",
      rowHeightTolerance: 0.25,
      onJustify: function () { gallery.classList.add("is-ready"); }
    });

    lightGallery(gallery, {
      selector: ".gallery-item",
      plugins: [lgZoom, lgThumbnail],
      speed: 400,
      download: false,
      zoomFromOrigin: false,
      licenseKey: "0000-0000-000-0000"
    });

    var lastRH = rowH(), rt;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      clearTimeout(rt);
      rt = setTimeout(function () {
        var nh = rowH();
        if (nh !== lastRH) { lastRH = nh; fjGallery(gallery, "updateOptions", { rowHeight: nh }); }
      }, 200);
    });
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
